title: When Do Learned Blocks Preserve Causal Meaning? Block Identifiability and Constructive Causal Abstractions
abstract: arXiv:2610.18155v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Standard identifiability theory assumes one-dimensional latent factors, but learned representations can encode latent information across multidimensional blocks whose internal coordinates are not uniquely determined. When such blocks are used to represent and intervene on higher-level concepts, it is unclear whether their causal meaning survives the transformations left unresolved by block-identifiability. We connect block-identifiability to constructive causal abstraction. We show that block-diagonal invertible transformations followed by compatible coordinate permutations form the maximal class that preserves every constructive causal abstraction built on those blocks. This guarantee assumes that the correspondence between blocks and concepts is updated with the representation. translated_title: 何时学习到的块能保留因果意义？块可辨识性与构造性因果抽象
translated_abstract: 标准可辨识性理论假设一维潜在因子，但学习到的表示可以在多维块中编码潜在信息，而这些块的内部坐标并非唯一确定。当这些块被用来表示更高层次的概念并对其进行干预时，尚不清楚它们的因果意义是否能在块可辨识性未能解决的其他变换下保留下来。我们将块可辨识性与构造性因果抽象联系起来，证明块对角可逆变换加上相容的坐标置换构成了能保留基于这些块构建的所有构造性因果抽象的最大变换类。这一保证假设块与概念之间的对应关系随表示一起更新。一个使用加性自编码器的小型合成实验表明，高层干预可以在独立学习到的表示之间进行迁移。
tldr: 该论文证明了块对角可逆变换加上相容坐标置换是保留学习表示中块因果意义的最大变换类，从而将块可辨识性与构造性因果抽象联系起来，使高层干预能够在独立学习到的表示之间迁移。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that block-diagonal invertible transformations followed by compatible coordinate permutations form the maximal class preserving the causal meaning of learned blocks, thereby connecting block identifiability with constructive causal abstraction and enabling the transfer of high-level interventions between independently learned representations.
